children: MYR Group entered into a Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement to enhance liquidity and refinance debt. The five-year facilities include a $690 million revolving credit line and term loans of $150 million and C$70 million with an option to expand commitments by up to $445 million. The revolver supports multi-currency borrowing, up to $100 million in letters of credit, and a $25 million swingline. The secured facilities include leverage and interest coverage covenants and are expected to support working capital, capex, acquisitions and general corporate purposes.
: Secured five-year revolving and term loan credit facilities
: JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and other lenders
: Refinance debt and support liquidity for growth initiatives
